title: DCA bot settings
description: The settings a live DCA bot runs on (decision 0016 §2, §7.2), as the reducer takes them: written by hand to mirror src/domain/dca/live.ts (DcaLiveConfig), kept equal by tests/dca/live-schema.test.ts. Each `default` is goodcryptoX's form default as ruled in 0016 §2 (what a hidden field takes); each range is the old form's. Every money, price and percentage value is a decimal string; counts and times are integers. The account, the instrument, margin and leverage, name and note join this with the create route (slice L2); the TA start's periods and signals came with the signal engine (decision 0017, slice T2). The domain refuses what a pattern cannot (validateLiveConfig): a trailing take-profit that can exit below the average, an amount of zero, the lower bound of each range.

investment.description: A3 d100: absent means quote. Quote is form metadata. Account is a percent of held account value: Approx. margin on perps (ladder margin plus the stop-loss reserve; without a stop, margin and fees plus the loss at the last averaging level), orders total on spot. Exact resolved sizing is journaled; replay never re-reads.

reinvest.description: A2 d70: grow each new cycle by all realized profit, fees and funding included; ignored with account investment

entryCondition.description: When a cycle's entry starts: at once and after each cooldown (manual), on a TA signal (ta; needs taPeriods and taSignals), on a TradingView webhook. POST /api/v1/bots refuses webhook with the named error `entry-condition-not-yet` until the Signal bot ships (release plan v4 §10). goodcryptoX's form defaulted to ta; the panel form opens on Signal too (T3), and this default stays manual: a create that omits the field must not wait on a signal nobody set.

entrySide.description: manual: buy or sell. ta: direct (the signal's side) or inverse. webhook: direct.

taPeriods.description: ta: the candle periods rated, the venue's own (Hyperliquid's fourteen); every one must agree for the bot to start (decision 0017 d8, d9). Required with ta, refused otherwise.

taSignals.description: ta: Detect signals. Buy starts at a rating above 0.1 (a score of 3 of 26), Strong Buy above 0.5 (14 of 26), Sell and Strong Sell the mirror; Buy includes Strong Buy. Required with ta, refused otherwise.

entryDistancePct.description: limit: this far from the market when the entry is made, 0 to 99; trailing: the bounce off the extreme, 0.1 to 99 (§2 row 7).

sizingMode.description: cost: amounts in the quote currency; size: in the base coin.

averaging.description: one: every level a stop-limit triggered at the previous level, one resting at a time (goodcryptoX); all: every level a resting limit at once.

postOnly.description: Averaging limits post-only; a level the market runs through fails with the averaging-error notification (RULINGS 132); Fix failed restores it.

level1Amount.description: Level 1's amount, sent as given. The panel form's Auto sends entryAmount × sizeCostMultiplier (MH 630; goodcryptoX's DEX Auto sent the entry's own amount); its Manual row starts there and follows until typed.

level1PricePct.description: Entry to averaging level 1; no multiplier. 0.01 to 99 (§2 row 13). The panel form's Auto sends avgPriceStepPct (C B2, MH 630); its Manual row starts there and follows until typed (MH 628 (a)).

sizeCostMultiplier.description: From level 2, each amount is the previous one times this. 0.01 to 10 (§2 row 14).

priceStepMultiplier.description: From level 3, each gap is the previous gap times this. 0.1 to 10 (§2 row 16).

bracketReduceOnly.description: MH366: TP/SL reduce-only preference copied at bot launch. Absent in old stored settings means true; later preference edits do not modify a running bot.

tpType.description: market: gcx watches the take-profit price and, when the last price reaches it, sends one market order for what the cycle holds; nothing rests on the exchange (goodcryptoX's Stop Market; added 2026-10-08, MH; a build before it reads it as a trailing take-profit of distance 0). limit: rests on the exchange at that price. trailing: starts trailing there and exits when the price falls back by tpTrailingDistancePct. market and limit take the same price.

tpPct.description: From the average entry price (or the entry order's price with tpFixedFromEntry). Above 0 and at most 99 with the take-profit on (§2 row 19; the form's 0 is tpEnabled false).

tpTrailingDistancePct.description: Required for a trailing take-profit; 0.1 to 99, and below tp/(1+tp) for a long, tp/(1-tp) for a short (§2 row 20).

slPct.description: Beyond the last averaging level (the entry with none). Above 0 and at most 99 with the stop-loss on (§2 row 23; the form's 0 is slEnabled false). 10 by the owner's ruling (release plan v4 A20, W21); goodcryptoX's was 15.

slLossPct.description: Added 2026-10-17 (MH 623 (c)-(f)); optional, absent: the stop is `slPct`, as before. The stop as the expected loss: a percent, above 0, of the money the bot uses (spot: the orders' value; perpetual: their margin, the value divided by the leverage; fees and the loss itself are not in it). Each cycle works out its stop for the side it opens and the account's leverage then, rounded so the loss is never more than this and within a tick of it, and keeps it for the cycle; when the loss is reached before the last averaging order, the stop goes inside the ladder and the averaging orders past it are not placed. `slPct` stays required: the distance a build before this one runs on, and what a cycle uses when the leverage could not be read. Only with slEnabled.

repeatOnTp.description: A new cycle after a take-profit, a Close pos. or any close that is not the stop-loss.

cooldownMs.description: The wait between cycles, in milliseconds: the form's menu offers none, 5 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 6 hours and 1 day; any other whole length is a custom one (added 2026-10-17, MH 708; before, only those six were accepted).

closeOnStop.description: Stop closes the position at market.

wholePosition.description: Only this bot trades this pair (was "Only gcx trades this coin"; MH 2026-10-05 line 33, 2026-10-06 rules 321 and 322; decision 0028 d21): a comparison only, never a size. On, a difference between the exchange's position on the coin and the bot's count on two reads gcx can trust waits for the person (red), and something else seen trading the pair (a fill or an order resting at the exchange that is not this bot's) is a notice (yellow); on spot only fewer coins than the bot counts differ. "Exchange is right" then counts every fill on the pair as this bot's. Off: nothing is raised. On only for the single bot on a pair: a bot created beside another that is not done is made with it off, and those with it on turn it off. Changed at once by modify. The take-profit, the stop-loss and every close sell only what the bot bought, on or off. Required on every create; the form starts ticked (unticked on perpetuals with a position open on the coin).

startAt.description: When to start, ms since the epoch.

endAt.description: When to stop, ms since the epoch.

atEnd.description: At the end time: finish the cycle; exit now (close); stop and keep the position.

decimal.description: A plain unsigned decimal string, never a JSON number.

pct99.description: A decimal string from 0 to 99, the old form's top for every percentage (AF:1809-1865); the lower bound of each field is the domain's (validateLiveConfig).

mult10.description: A decimal string from 0 to 10, the old form's top for a multiplier (AF:1825-1840); the lower bound is the domain's.
